nodes.name: Góc giữa hai vectơ
nodes.description: Góc giữa hai vectơ không phải vectơ không, là góc giữa hai vectơ có điểm đầu trùng nhau.

nodes.name: Công thức tính góc giữa hai vectơ
nodes.description: Biểu thức tính góc giữa hai vectơ dựa trên tọa độ của chúng.

assignments.rationale: This occurrence defines the concept of the angle between two vectors in the plane (grade 10). It is the core concept.

This occurrence defines the concept of the angle between two vectors in space (grade 12). The definition is conceptually the same as in grade 10 (angle between two vectors with a common origin), just extended to 3D. Grade differences alone are not a reason to split.

This occurrence is a FORMULA for calculating the angle between two vectors using coordinates. It is a different type of knowledge (FORMULA vs. CONCEPT) and represents a specific computational method. It should be split from the concept node.
